articles.title: FirstCash Announces Planned Leadership Succession
articles.summary: FORT WORTH, Texas, July 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- FirstCash Holdings, Inc. (“FirstCash” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: FCFS), the leading international operator of pawn stores focused on serving cash and credit-constrained consumers, today announced planned senior leadership transitions as part of the Company’s long-term succession planning. Rick L. Wessel, current Chief Executive Officer and Vice-Chairman of the Board, will transition to the role of Executive Chairman, effective January 1, 2027.
